about_the_game:
This Pack includes:

  • F/A-18С Early (Rank 8 USA);

  • Premium account for 30 days;

  • 3000 Golden Eagles.

The F/A-18C Early is an earlier modification of this legendary multirole fighter-bomber developed by McDonnell Douglas in the late 1970s.

It features an AN/APG-65 radar with advanced tracking and engagement capabilities, along with a large number of AIM-9L and AIM-7M air-to-air missiles and a 20 mm Vulcan cannon. For ground combat, you can equip a wide array of guided weaponry, including the GBU-12, GBU-16, GBU-10, and GBU-24 laser guided bombs, and the AGM-65E and AGM-65F Maverick guided missiles along with a thermal targeting pod. On top of the impressive arsenal is similarly impressive flight performance, with high speed, climb rate, and very high agility.

One of the greats, the F/A-18C Early is a highly capable aircraft, excelling in both air combat and close air support roles.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same vehicle or you already have the vehicle from this pack!

  • Available for Linux, Windows and Mac only. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account.
